 Bayern Munich’s Michael Olise finished 9th in Ballon d’Or voting
 FC Bayern did very well.
 by CSmith1919 Updated Oct 28, 2026, 6:45 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 (Photo by FRANCK FIFE / AFP via Getty Images) AFP via Getty Images Part Of Bayern Munich at the 2026 Ballon d’Or Awards see all updates CSmith1919 Chuck Smith is the site manager for Bavarian Football Works, where he began writing in 2017. He is the author of The Daily Schmankerl, the longest-running daily Bayern Munich column in English, and also writes The Weekend Warm-Up. In addition to covering Bayern Munich news and providing commentary on Bayern Munich, the Bundesliga, and the German national team. He brings more than 30 years of sports-writing experience to the site. Over the course of his career, he has written for numerous newspapers and websites. Michael Olise has finished ninth in the Ballon d’Or voting, earning a place among the top 10 players in world football alongside some truly elite company. Not a bad achievement for a player who has continued to elevate his game since joining Bayern Munich!
 Olise has been outstanding, combining creativity, technical brilliance, and an eye for goal to become one of Bayern Munich’s most influential attacking players. His ability to unlock defenses, create chances for teammates, and produce moments of individual magic has made him a nightmare for opposing defenders. Finishing ninth is recognition of just how far he has come, with plenty of room for even more growth.
 And what makes the evening even sweeter for Bayern Munich supporters? Olise’s teammate, Harry Kane, took home the top prize, finishing first in the voting. Having two Bayern Munich stars featured so prominently is a testament to the quality within Vincent Kompany’s squad.
 @iMiaSanMia compiled the ranking based on votes:
 Harry Kane 
 Kylian Mbappé 
 Lamine Yamal 
 Rodri 
 Lionel Messi 
 Khvicha Kvaratskhelia 
 Ousmane Dembélé 
 Erling Haaland 
 Michael Olise 
 Fabián Ruiz 
 Kane gets the crown, Olise cracks the top 10, and Bayern Munich has plenty to celebrate!
